description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart showing the distribution of content types in the DODa (Darija Open Dataset) Version 2, with 6 slices corresponding to the categories listed in the legend. The largest slices include Translated Sentences in yellow (labeled 45,387, visually about one-third of the ring), Pending Translations in green (labeled 43,000, just under one-third), Extra + Augmented Data in blue (labeled 30,000, roughly one-fifth), and Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives) in orange (labeled 23,108, roughly one-sixth). Two additional slices are very thin slivers without visible numeric labels: Moroccan Names in a reddish-orange color and Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy) in purple, each appearing to represent well under a few percent of the total. A legend is shown on the right mapping colors to labels, and the larger slices contain count labels rather than percentage labels; no slices appear exploded or offset, and the segments are arranged around the ring without an explicitly indicated sorting rule beyond the visual placement.
